Someone explain why our top-tier heavy is sniping from spawn while three mediums hold the entire city flank. We baited their whole platoon into the quarry, then Priya's medium clipped the artillery sitting naked at spawn. At three hundred meters, his upper glacis autobounces anything we carry, so aim for the cupola or the machine-gun port. Heat shimmer bent the horizon until the distant hulks looked like they were floating. Reloading, four seconds — hug the rubble and pray his gunner is asleep.
